comparison.objective: Lift and pour simulated molten metal with a two-handle shank into the dry mould.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load carrying and controlled tipping, not coaxial mandrel alignment and striking.
comparison.success_condition: Contents enter the dry mould; avoid the wet mould, direct crucible contact, and unsafe handling.
comparison.reason: Rigid beads and two-arm coordination are generic similarities only; the central pour/hazard choice differs from fastener finishing. No specs or quantitative spill/completion thresholds are supplied.
